---
title: smalldocs 0.5.3
subtitle: A fix for divs in list items
date: 2026-10-22
author: Rahul Dave
categories: [release]
image: ../images/mark.svg
---

This release fixes a div, such as a callout, inside a list item.

When the div had no `:::` to end it, the list item ended it at the next line that was not indented.
That line was lost from the page. Now the page keeps it, as Pandoc does.

In a notebook, this showed when a callout in a list had no end before a code cell.
The code cell lost its start, so a stray `:::` showed on the page. Now the cell shows as it should.
